status: Prior whole-house, first-floor and second-floor audit history retained. Selected dining/living and upper-floor plan corrections visually reviewed; proposed for homeowner feedback. Measurements, products and omitted-space scope remain open.

reviewed.method: Visual comparison of every current day/night render, existing builder-plan previews, room schedules, window schedule, guide and budget exclusions. No site measurements, product tests or concealed conditions verified.

verdict: The original Mineral & Walnut direction remains. FB-017 identified first-floor window-count/size, doorway-offset and furniture/composition errors requiring another targeted correction pass. Entry wording, office printer location and media seating/TV wall are updated requirements; do not treat published prior views as verified construction elevations.

runner.decision: No stair runner. The homeowner has selected exposed wood stairs across all floors.
runner.reason: Natural oak and warm white risers keep the stair visually quiet within the original Mineral & Walnut palette.
runner.refinement: Natural oak treads and landings, warm white painted risers, and the existing dark handrails and white balusters.
runner.tradeoff: This choice removes carpet supply and specialist fitting from the scope; retain the existing stair refinishing and lighting plans.
runner.status: Current day/night views show exposed steps. Prior runner proposals are superseded.
runner.cost: Runner supply and fitting allowances removed; existing stair refinishing remains.

priorities.title: Resolve the furniture plan
priorities.text: Formal dining, sunroom, piano salon, media seating and Bedroom 2 are the highest fit risks. Full-size furniture footprints and opening clearances come before another styling pass.

priorities.title: Complete the missing spaces
priorities.text: The main-level powder room, walk-in pantry, menu center, butler’s pantry and main-level terrace need explicit design decisions. Their existence and exact configuration must be checked against this house. Powder/pantry remodels are expressly excluded from the current base estimate beyond shared dry-area paint.

priorities.title: Make the render set tell one consistent story
priorities.text: The revised set coordinates oak bedroom floors, media finishes and glazing, room-specific window layers and day/night furnishings. Source views and derived concepts are labeled; confirm unseen junctions and dimensions on site.

priorities.title: Make lighting useful and controllable
priorities.text: Separate arrival, conversation, movie, reading, task and cleaning scenes. The salon needs a lower light layer, media art lights should dim/off for films, and suite LEDs should not dominate every evening scene. Choose actual dimmable products and test them; rendered orange/pink color casts do not identify a lamp or paint color.

priorities.title: Give the rooms personal identity
priorities.text: Keep the neutral palette and greenery. Replace some repeated beige abstract pairs with personally meaningful photography, a single larger artwork, textile art or a sculptural object. Retain the requested sibling artwork in the great room and bed art. Give dining and sunroom distinct pendant silhouettes.

priorities.title: Finish everyday comfort and storage
priorities.text: Plan where keys, bags, shoes, drinks, chargers, luggage, towels, toiletries, laundry, cleaning tools and seasonal decorations live. Much is mentioned in allowances but not located or dimensioned. Test actual seat and mattress comfort; hide cables and allow service access.

priorities.title: Spend on finish quality where it shows
priorities.text: Use one natural-oak sample, one coordinated walnut stain family and a small controlled paint/trim palette. Use specialty mineral finish selectively, quality washable coatings elsewhere, and appropriate wet-area finishes. Refine installation and proportion before commissioning more wall panels or bespoke cabinetry.

fitChecks.text: Formal dining plan zone 155 × 183 in. Revised closed table target 84 × 40 in gives nominal centered end gaps of 49.5 in and side gaps of 57.5 in before chairs, trim or storage. A 108-in extended table reduces end gaps to 37.5 in. These are planning arithmetic, not verified usable clearance; test all chairs and supports before ordering.

Plan zone 147 × 111 in; proposed table 72 × 34 in. Centered nominal gaps are 37.5 in at ends and 38.5 in at sides before chair pullback, drape stacks and obstructions. Check the nearby oven and terrace-door operation with all seats in use.

The printed living-room zone is 16 ft × 11 ft 4 in. A roughly 5-ft piano and 96-in sofa are only concepts. Verify the selected piano case, open lid, bench travel and delivery route with actual seating footprints.

missingSpaces.title: Main-level powder room
missingSpaces.action: Develop a compact guest-facing room with a distinctive mirror/light pairing and one restrained finish choice. Verify existing services before scope/pricing.

missingSpaces.title: Walk-in pantry, menu center and butler’s pantry
missingSpaces.action: Inventory food, serving pieces, small appliances and charging/mail needs; allocate useful closed storage and task light. Confirm which builder options are actually present.

missingSpaces.title: Main-level terrace
missingSpaces.action: Treat separately from the roof terrace. Resolve seating, planting, doors, privacy and maintenance from its actual photographs and dimensions.

missingSpaces.title: Hall, coat/linen and utility storage
missingSpaces.action: Locate practical storage for shoes, linen, luggage, cleaning tools and seasonal decorations. These need a schedule even when they do not need a hero render.

rooms.title: Entrance gallery
rooms.status: FB-017 correction required · replacement images and QA pending
rooms.keep: The cascade chandelier, light glazed doors and open gallery make a strong arrival.
rooms.finding: E1/E2 strong peach cast and knotty orange boards; E1 runner boundary too dark. E2 remains an inferred front-facing view anchored to actual exterior entry photos.
rooms.action: Keep light clear doors, cascade chandelier, matched oak and uncovered existing staircase. Replace painted arch wording with “Welcome Home” and raised departure wording with “See you next time.” Confirm full-size typography templates and finish-compatible application.
rooms.previousFinding: The wood and wall color read pinker than adjacent rooms in the renders; two inscriptions plus the chandelier already provide enough visual detail. A daily drop zone is only described in the notes.
rooms.rendered: Published prior images remain; the corrections below are instructions, not a statement that new renders have passed QA.
rooms.priorRenderAssessment: Light glazed doors, two-story chandelier and natural oak floor retained. The staircase beyond the arch has exposed oak treads and warm white risers, without a runner.

rooms.title: Home office
rooms.status: FB-017 correction required · replacement images and QA pending
rooms.keep: The walnut wall, integrated TV and large desk have a clear purpose.
rooms.finding: Both main banks need centered paired 2×2 glazing; thin decorative bars were misread as a third structural unit. Reverse doorway is too centered, and printer/art are on the wrong side.
rooms.action: Move clear gallery pair toward right of reverse wall, retaining small circular window to left. Put compact printer cabinet and neutral framed art on larger left wall section, clear of door swing and window. Keep north TV/library/soundbar and southeast task seat facing northwest. Survey all openings, printer operation and complete furniture footprint.
rooms.previousFinding: The repeated open upper bays risk looking like a display showroom; equipment service, chair movement and work lighting still need detailing.
rooms.rendered: Published prior images remain; the corrections below are instructions, not a statement that new renders have passed QA.
rooms.priorRenderAssessment: Both original window banks now visible at correct relative sizes (two front/three right); full interior-wall TV joinery, desk and no window counter. Task seat restored to window side, with visitors toward built-in; clear gallery doors, printer and art retained. Desk alignment remains a measured furniture-plan decision.

rooms.title: Media room
rooms.status: FB-017 correction required · replacement images and QA pending
rooms.keep: The large screen, deep seating and restrained TV backing suit the cinema brief.
rooms.finding: Main paired window is too large and reverse doorway too centered. Homeowner confirms sofa-wall exterior feature is fake and has no interior opening. Current TV box/seating composition does not meet the revised brief.
rooms.action: Real main window: smaller centered paired 2×2. Keep sofa wall solid in both cameras/night pairs. Shift clear doors toward TV corner, keeping display to right. Show 83-inch screen, quiet mineral/acoustic fitted wall and wider integrated 96–102-inch walnut console. Use shallow room-side service construction, not shared-wall excavation. Cloud Classic-scale sofa plus TWO ottomans, slim side tables and compact central table require measured fit. Coordinate audio and independently dimmed movie/display/general scenes.
rooms.previousFinding: M1 and M2 disagree on the sofa-wall darkness; M2 glass reads tinted/frosted. The night image lights art and the TV halo more brightly than a movie scene should. Ceiling grilles are not an audio plan.
rooms.rendered: Published prior images remain; the corrections below are instructions, not a statement that new renders have passed QA.
rooms.priorRenderAssessment: Broad paired window restored; neutral daylight and calm TV panel with soundbar/ceiling audio retained. Opening dimensions remain subject to survey. Reverse media view places clear gallery doors on adjoining west wall, slim figurine shelves to right and coherent TV/console/sectional/audio.

rooms.title: Studio gym
rooms.status: Images revised · measure before ordering
rooms.keep: The empty mirrored room and quote respect the equipment-later brief.
rooms.finding: Window banks and empty-room brief retained, but closet/bath projection and reflection need checking against original and plan; pink cast.
rooms.action: Keep the room empty. Confirm closet and bath access, durable washable wall finish, floor compatibility and useful glare-controlled lighting; reserve services for the equipment eventually selected.
rooms.previousFinding: The two door functions, northwest closet access, mirror fixing and future equipment clearances need a measured plan.
rooms.rendered: Empty gym now includes empty mirror reflection; original paired window and plan closet/bath access retained. Gym reverse now empty; clear paired doors, small portico window and wide paired street window retained.

rooms.title: Bath #3

rooms.keep: The quiet porcelain, walnut and simple mirror work.
rooms.finding: B1/B2 agree with plan-led vanity/toilet opposite shower; no original photo. Keep compact shell, add practical accessories only.
rooms.action: Retain windowless compact shell, vanity/toilet opposite shower and existing B2 right-hand bench. Verify staggered studio-near-vanity versus hall-near-shower doors, handing and simultaneous privacy. Retain practical accessory/storage and compatible waterproofing/ventilation requirements.
rooms.previousFinding: Towel/robe storage and accessory positions are underdeveloped; the plan-led geometry is not surveyed.
rooms.rendered: Published prior images remain; the corrections below are instructions, not a statement that new renders have passed QA.
rooms.priorRenderAssessment: Ivory porcelain floor restored; vanity/toilet end, two side accesses and windowless plan retained. Reverse windowless Bath 3 view shows shower opposite vanity/toilet, with side access doors and coordinated porcelain.

rooms.title: Great room
rooms.status: Images revised · measure before ordering
rooms.keep: This is one of the strongest rooms: ivory seating, walnut storage, sibling art and the fireplace form a coherent composition.
rooms.finding: GR1/GR2 broadly retain source architecture; restore real terrace mullions/transom proportions and make furnishings less repetitive, maintain sibling artworks.
rooms.action: Keep the sibling-art requirement. Add a reachable drink table at the lounge chair if the measured layout permits; choose actual comfortable upholstery and a distinctive textile weave. Test TV height full-size from the selected sofa. Avoid adding another feature wall.
rooms.previousFinding: The above-fireplace TV needs a seated-height and product-clearance check. Tables and art are attractive but repeat the same formula used elsewhere.
rooms.rendered: Two high transoms and terrace glazing retained; sibling art, seating and reachable drink table coordinated. Companion great-room camera retains transoms, terrace glazing, sibling artworks and furnishing layout.

rooms.title: Kitchen
rooms.status: Images revised · measure before ordering
rooms.keep: The retained service layout, dark dome pendants and walnut island belong to the palette.
rooms.finding: K2 relocated refrigerator to long cooktop run; work aisle/reverse architecture wrong. K1 warm cast and busy counter. Coordinate sunroom sightline.
rooms.action: Sample a quieter pale counter and warm-ivory cabinet finish, with simple door profiles if replacing cabinets. Coordinate backsplash and counters. Verify island seating, landing surfaces, ventilation, appliance cut sheets and task-light glare. Correct image white balance before judging paint undertones.
rooms.previousFinding: The counter looks busier than the calm stone language elsewhere; gray cabinet color and orange/pink image casts weaken consistency. Four stools and appliance-door clearances have not been measured.
rooms.rendered: Original refrigerator return, cooktop, window and oven column retained; cabinetry warmed, four stools and sunroom retained. Physical counter sample governs subtle veining. Actual reverse kitchen photo anchors refrigerator return, work aisle, sink/DW and archways; finish and dome pendants match K1.

rooms.title: Formal dining
rooms.status: Source/plan revision visually reviewed · proposed for homeowner feedback
rooms.keep: The rectangular table and daylight are right for this house.
rooms.finding: A neutral Mineral & Walnut dining room directly open to the living/piano salon. Follow the builder furniture plan: walnut rectangular table along north–south with EIGHT dining places (three per long side and one at each end), plus TWO separate curved ivory occasional chairs in the east window-side corners. Retain the west sideboard/art and real south-end butler passage, two south arches, two east rectangles/transoms and the single high small east arch with shallow walnut shelf. No dividing portal or header.
rooms.action: Verify actual opening offsets, product dimensions, furniture clearances and services before procurement or construction.
rooms.previousFinding: The 108 × 42-inch ten-seat concept is tight at the ends after cabinets. The small open shelf creates another display area; the chandelier closely repeats the sunroom.
rooms.rendered: Selected replacement views and their exact-source night mates visually reviewed; retained views remain documented. This is design visualization QA, not measured construction approval.

priorR07Assessment.finding: D1 window heights distorted, ten-seat fixed-table clearance unresolved. D2 small arch enlarged and rendered without reference room context.
priorR07Assessment.action: Prefer a high-quality extension table: comfortable everyday size, ten seats when entertaining if a measured plan passes. Test slim chairs, supports and storage projection. Keep the requested feature below the high window shallow and useful. Choose a more substantial sculptural dining light, distinct from the airy sunroom fixture.
priorR07Assessment.rendered: Five photographed opening locations and high arch retained; eight-seat closed extension table, shallow shelf and differentiated pendant shown. Useful high-window/shelf detail preserves small high arch and adjacent tall windows without enlarging opening.

TWO separate ivory sofas form an L: long three-seat sofa at the east windows facing west, shorter two-seat sofa on the southern dining boundary facing north with its back toward dining. Rectangular walnut coffee table, two end tables and oatmeal rug accompany a diagonal compact grand in the northwest stair-side corner, curved tail northwest and keyboard/bench southeast. Retain two real east windows and a solid north interior behind the exterior false window. No invented stair doorway or dining partition.
rooms.action: Verify actual opening offsets, product dimensions, furniture clearances and services before procurement or construction.

priorR07Assessment.action: Template the exact piano, open lid, bench withdrawal, sofa and chair together. Add one good reading lamp and a reachable small table. Keep artwork singular and expressive. Confirm piano delivery and location against direct sun/air supply using the selected maker’s guidance.
priorR07Assessment.rendered: Plan-led living study now shows open dining boundary, two front living windows, solid east-side wall, compact piano/sofa/chair arrangement and no invented portal. Tighter framing excludes unsupported ceiling details; no dedicated living photograph exists. Piano-side secondary concept retains two front windows, sofa at the open dining boundary, one chair, walnut table and baby grand. No dedicated room photograph; the apparent header at the dining opening is an unverified junction, not a proposed structural alteration or confirmed existing beam.

rooms.title: Sunroom
rooms.status: Images revised · measure before ordering
rooms.keep: Six-place everyday dining with light sheers is appropriate.
rooms.finding: S1/S2 nearly identical. Original oven/window geometry broadly retained. Match warm ivory kitchen and provide second meaningful source-adjacent view.
rooms.action: Retain six seats with slim, comfortable chairs and a rounded-corner rectangular table. Tape the footprint and move real chairs before ordering. Keep the chandelier visually light, tracks simple and appliance/terrace access clear.
rooms.previousFinding: Nominal 72 × 34-inch furniture in the 147 × 111-inch zone leaves limited space once chairs, curtains and nearby oven/door operation are included. Both images show almost the same angle.
rooms.rendered: Window banks, transoms/knee walls, oven column and terrace door preserved; six-seat table and privacy layers visible. Closer kitchen-side sunroom perspective retains six chairs, wraparound transoms and knee walls, pendant and layers.

rooms.finding: Runner renders straightened/enlarged lower flight and lost original tread fan; adjoining great room retained model furniture. Both existing views nearly same.
rooms.action: Confirm a coordinated physical oak finish sample and preserve all existing tread, riser, landing and guard geometry. No stair carpet is to be ordered.
rooms.previousFinding: The dark-edged runner adds another strong line beside tread noses and balusters. ST1 and ST2 offer little additional geometry coverage.
rooms.rendered: Exposed natural oak treads, warm white risers and dark handrails. Preserve the corrected curved/fanned flight, intermediate landing, side arch, window pair and stairwell opening; no carpet runner.

Keep the four west sash units, open southwest retreat connection and south-wall 55-inch TV with soundbar; real arched bath/closet access lies farther east toward the paired east vestibule doors/transom. No doorway between the TV and west windows. Bed/bedside underside lighting is restrained; dressers do not gain unselected lighting.
rooms.action: Verify actual opening offsets, product dimensions, furniture clearances and services before procurement or construction.

rooms.rendered: Selected replacement views and their exact-source night mates visually reviewed; retained views remain documented. This is design visualization QA, not measured construction approval.

Retain artwork over the bed but select a distinctive composition. Prioritize mattress, bedding, reading comfort and bedside charging over extra built-outs.

priorR07Assessment.action: Reconcile the adjoining suite with current oak flooring, loose rugs and the approved bed/headwall. Use a useful tray and restrained coffee setup. Keep blackout coordinated with the open bedroom connection; consider quiet appliance operation when selecting the beverage unit.
priorR07Assessment.rendered: Neutral walnut coffee bar and seating retained; the adjoining primary bedroom again shows its original neutral bedding.

Keep mineral decoration in suitable dry areas. Specify lighting at faces and the full shower waterproofing/ventilation system; no extra decorative wall is necessary.
priorR07Assessment.rendered: Porcelain floor restored; source shower, tub, vanity and two-window arrangement retained. Companion bathroom study retains original camera/fixture zone and corrected porcelain; little additional unseen geometry is claimed.

sources.title: Portola — Roman Clay application and limitations
sources.note: Roman Clay is for smooth interior walls and is not specified by the manufacturer for wet areas such as inside showers. Select the full substrate/finish system for each location.
